title: MedResearcher-R1: Expert-Level Medical Deep Researcher via A Knowledge-Informed Trajectory Synthesis Framework
abstract: arXiv:2508.14880v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in deep research tasks, yet their application to the medical domain remains challenging. The leading proprietary systems achieve only modest results on complex medical benchmarks. This exposes two key bottlenecks: (i) limited clinical-reasoning capability in the underlying model, and (ii) unreliable access to authoritative medical evidence when constrained to open-web retrieval. To address these limitations and equip agents with robust clinical reasoning capabilities, we present MedResearcher-R1, a medical deep research agent featuring two core innovations. First, we propose Knowledge-Informed Trajectory Synthesis (KISA), a novel approach that builds medical knowledge graphs to construct complex multi-hop question-answer pairs centered on rare medical entities, overcoming the scarcity of high-quality domain-specific training data. translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体近年来在深度研究任务中展现出卓越的能力，但其在医学领域的应用仍然充满挑战。目前领先的专有系统在复杂的医学基准测试中仅能取得平庸的成绩。这暴露出两个关键瓶颈：（i）底层模型的临床推理能力有限；（ii）在仅依赖开放网络检索时，难以可靠地获取权威医学证据。为了解决这些局限并使智能体具备强大的临床推理能力，我们提出了 MedResearcher-R1——一个具有两项核心创新的医学深度研究智能体。首先，我们提出了知识知情轨迹合成，这是一种新颖的方法，通过构建医学知识图谱来生成以罕见医学实体为中心的复杂多跳问答对，从而克服高质量领域特定训练数据稀缺的问题。其次，我们……（原文摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出医学深度研究智能体 MedResearcher-R1，其核心创新是知识知情轨迹合成（KISA）——通过构建医学知识图谱生成以罕见医学实体为中心的复杂多跳问答训练数据，并配合其他创新（摘要中被截断），从而突破医学领域高质量训练数据稀缺与临床推理能力不足的瓶颈，实现专家级医学深度研究。
en_tdlr: The paper presents MedResearcher-R1, a medical deep research agent whose key innovation is Knowledge-Informed Trajectory Synthesis (KISA), which builds medical knowledge graphs to construct complex multi-hop question-answer pairs centered on rare medical entities, overcoming the scarcity of high-quality domain-specific training data to achieve expert-level medical deep research.
